faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Associate - II position at CSIR NIO is 13th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Associate - II position in the CSIR NIO recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - II role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Sc in Botany, Zoology, Bioinformatics, Marine Science (Biology specialization), Oceanography (Biology specialization), Marine Biotechnology, or Marine Microbiology, with at least two years of post-M.Sc research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Associate - II post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate - II role at CSIR NIO will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography is located in Goa, India.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position, meaning it is not a permanent government job. The duration of the contract will be as per the institute's requirements.
